annotation.authors_or_issuer: Tsujita, T.; Sakuma, Y.; Yamada, S.; Eto, R.; Kurosaki, M.
key_provisions_or_claims: Interprets Additional Protocol I articles (48, 51, 57, etc.) to derive requirements for sentry robots.
Proposes an operation regulation framework based on distinction, proportionality and precaution.
Defines legal indicators: certainty, effort, nexus possibility, necessity, collateral damage.
Uses a real robot with terahertz and visible cameras to detect suicide bombers.
Aims to protect civilians and parties to a conflict from suicide bombings.
annotation.summary_en: Journal article from the National Defense Academy of Japan proposing an operation regulation framework for sentry robots under international humanitarian law. It interprets Additional Protocol I and defines legal indicators for distinction, proportionality and precaution, demonstrated on a real robot detecting suicide bombers.
annotation.title_clean: Study on an Operation Regulation Framework under International Humanitarian Law
annotation.title_en: Study on an Operation Regulation Framework under International Humanitarian Law
annotation.venue: Journal of the Robotics Society of Japan
